violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage and Service (26 TAC §746.3309(c))
violation_type.short_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage and Service
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection a jar of infant food was found opened in the cabinet in the classroom. When caregivers were asked how long it had been present they stated it had been there for a week, but not opened this week. The jar was observed to be labeled with instructions to refridgerate after opening and to discard 2 days after it was opened.     The jar was thrown away immediately.

finding_variants.text: At the time of the inspection a jar of infant food was found opened in the cabinet in the classroom. When caregivers were asked how long it had been present they stated it had been there for a week, but not opened this week. The jar was observed to be labeled with instructions to refridgerate after opening and to discard 2 days after it was opened.     The jar was thrown away immediately.
During the inspection, I observed multiple children's  meals provided by parents not stored properly.     Note: All meals were moved to a refrigerated area.

A frozen meal was left out on a counter top for at least an hour and twenty five minutes before it was cooked and served to a child in care. The box states to keep frozen and do not thaw. Additionally, one child was served pizza that had been sitting out on the counter for the same amount of time.
The operation failed to safely store the child's formula by misplacing it.
A child was observed eating a food item brought from home during lesson activity and child shared food item with other children.
